instruction: Develop a mutually composable mini-model gearbox with gears 1-6 without interrupting the current mission.
success_additions: machine-testable gear selection and upshift/downshift rules
at least one shared-base multi-adapter proof or equivalent composable specialist proof
high-risk or low-confidence events downshift to stricter deterministic control instead of escalating autonomy
gear changes are recorded in compact progress state and independently verifiable by LCR-C
